purpose: Persist proven engineering failures, root causes, fixes and prevention rules from agent chats so future agents reuse them before acting.

learnings.failureMode: A candidate branch becomes materially behind main and starts failing unrelated portal or Brain gates.
learnings.rootCause: Long-running branch accumulated divergence while independent lanes kept shipping.
learnings.prevention: Do not force old branches forward. Rebase/transplant only the scoped proven change onto current main when changed-path or declared-contract overlap exists.
learnings.gate: BRAIN delivery current-main file + contract conflict index

learnings.failureMode: A green preview or similar deploy is treated as proof for a different production identity.
learnings.rootCause: Environment success was confused with exact candidate identity.
learnings.prevention: Promote and verify exactly the SHA/artifact/revision that passed gates; any different identity is not green.
learnings.gate: BG169 exact candidate identity + Netlify exact-SHA status

learnings.failureMode: A fix overwrites newer portal, login, Brain or agent work.
learnings.rootCause: Concurrent changes were treated as disposable branch drift.
learnings.prevention: Never force-push/overwrite concurrent work; preserve current main and carry only explicit scoped files or contract-safe changes.
learnings.gate: expected-head guards + non-force ref updates + conflict index

learnings.failureMode: A production build imports a module but the intended transformation never runs.
learnings.rootCause: Side-effect execution was assumed from module import while the module only exported functions or guarded direct execution.
learnings.prevention: Build orchestration must call the exported operation explicitly and regression tests must verify generated output, not source presence.

learnings.failureMode: Different public pages drift to different footer markup, routes or SEO anchors.
learnings.rootCause: Footer copies were edited per page instead of generated from one source.
learnings.prevention: Use only .github/canoniek/voet.html as source and inject deterministically during the build; undeclared missing/different footers block release.
learnings.gate: footer contract + injection test + public footer smoke

learnings.failureMode: Sitewide footer anchors compete with the intended SEO landing-page owner.
learnings.rootCause: Anchor text and destination routes changed without checking the one-primary-keyword/one-owner strategy.
learnings.prevention: Validate every strategic footer destination and exact keyword anchor against site/seo-baseline.json before promotion.

learnings.failureMode: Agents burn time, tokens or Make operations repeating the same failed action.
learnings.rootCause: Retry was used instead of generating a new diagnostic hypothesis.
learnings.prevention: Maximum two identical retries without new evidence; then require a new hypothesis, fallback or root-cause fix.
learnings.gate: AGENTS self-healing contract + material outcome logging

learnings.failureMode: HTTP 2xx, Make success or green CI is accepted while the required business outcome is absent.
learnings.rootCause: Technical execution status was treated as outcome evidence.
learnings.prevention: Reconcile outcome obligations and verify the intended external result before terminal green.
learnings.gate: NO SILENT FAILURE / GREEN MEANS OUTCOME VERIFIED

learnings.failureMode: Unrelated work is blocked or rebuilt because main moved.
learnings.rootCause: Delivery was globally serialized instead of using scoped lanes and declared contracts.
learnings.prevention: Let non-conflicting lanes continue independently; synchronize only changed-path, merge or declared semantic-contract overlaps.

learnings.failureMode: A solved incident is rediscovered by another agent or chat.
learnings.rootCause: Root cause, failed approaches, fix and prevention were not persisted into shared memory.
learnings.prevention: Every material outcome writes ERROR/RECOVERY/IMPROVEMENT/CONTRACT_CHANGE/PRODUCTION_PROMOTION evidence to repo memory and BG168/BG167 before Definition of Done.

learnings.failureMode: A website change reaches production without proving real rendered behavior.
learnings.rootCause: Static/unit checks were considered sufficient for deployment-sensitive behavior.
learnings.prevention: Use exact-head Netlify preview and public HTTPS smoke before production promotion for website-visible changes.

learnings.failureMode: A shared SEO or footer change unintentionally mutates accepted historical V18 page content.
learnings.rootCause: Cross-cutting build transforms had an overly broad mutation boundary.
learnings.prevention: V18 body remains immutable outside explicitly scoped footer/head layers; compare stripped protected body in regression tests.
learnings.gate: V18 SEO layer + footer boundary regression

learnings.failureMode: A static build-order regression test reports a false failure although runtime call order is correct.
learnings.rootCause: The test used the first symbol occurrence and therefore matched import declarations instead of invocation statements.
learnings.prevention: Execution-order gates must inspect invocation-specific markers or actual generated/runtime behavior; never infer execution order from first identifier occurrence.

learnings.failureMode: A public landing page keeps an old shared component while nested pages receive the canonical one.
learnings.rootCause: The governed file patterns covered root HTML and nested blog entries but omitted the blog landing at blog/index.html.
learnings.prevention: Shared-component governance must explicitly cover collection landing pages as well as root pages and nested entries, and public smoke must include representative collection roots.
learnings.gate: footer contract governedGlobs + /blog/ public preview smoke

learnings.failureMode: A machine-readable exception list contains files that no longer exist or are not actually non-indexable.
learnings.rootCause: Exceptions were treated as static documentation rather than executable release contracts.
learnings.prevention: Every footer/governance exception must exist at test time, carry an explicit reason, and prove noindex; deleted surfaces must be removed from the exception list immediately.
learnings.gate: tests/footer-contract.test.mjs exception existence + robots noindex assertions
